source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
apple_status_message: No sessions found in the selected files.
notes: UTF-16 little-endian text with a byte-order mark and CRLF (what Windows PowerShell 5 writes with `>`).

Apple decodes files as UTF-8 only; this file yields no session and the message 'No sessions found in the selected files.' The web app detects the byte-order mark, decodes UTF-16 and imports the transcript, flagging the encoding it used.
